'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello, mercenary. I have been watching you for quite a while now, and I know that you are able to solve the tasks assigned to you. Don't get too cocky now, you're not the only one who knows how to follow orders. There are more fighters like you, even more competent. I want to offer you a job, to give you a chance to become a part of something bigger than you can imagine. If you are ready, then here's an assignment for you: my people operate all over Tarkov and often leave souvenirs after themselves. The mission is to obtain and deliver those items to me. No questions asked. The things are extremely rare. I hope I don't have to remind you that you have to obtain all these items by yourself? Believe me, I like no other know when people lie. You will be informed of the drop spot. And one more thing, all my partners have already mastered their skills a long time ago and proven themselves reliable, and if you want to be one of them, then prove to me that you are not inferior to them in training. Don't try to contact me, I will do it myself when the time comes.}}

==Requirements==
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Prapor]], [[Therapist]], [[Skier]], [[Peacekeeper]], [[Mechanic]], [[Ragman]] and [[Jaeger]]
* [[Scavs#Scav karma|Scav karma]] of at least +3
* Must be level 40 to start this quest.
* Complete the quests:
** [[Chemical - Part 3]]
** [[Sew it Good - Part 2]]
** [[Shooter Born in Heaven]]
** [[The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4]]

===Riddle===
Until April 19, 2019 this quest was called "A049 C026 0101PD". There was a riddle hidden in the the dialogue and reward text.

====Quest description decryption====
Solving the riddle starts with the quest description, the first paragraph of the hex encoded text equating to <code>At interchange we were at bash zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba pryz1uts8q5onmlkj3hgfe4c2a</code> and the second one to <code>6t th1 1na of 8t 6ll, 2ou must 58ll th1 58ll6 and UrAgCe DEroRRiM</code>. The first uncovered paragraph indicates the existence of Atbash ciphered text, the text <code>zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba pryz1uts8q5onmlkj3hgfe4c2a</code> equating to <code>abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz kiba1fgh8j5lmnopq3stuv4x2z</code>, a clear substitution pattern. Using the aforementioned substitution pattern, we can take the second paragraph found in the quest description and translate it to <code>6t the end of it 6ll, you must kill the kill6</code>, a clue which will become useful later along with the <code>UrAgCe</code> and <code>DEroRRiM</code> texts.  

====Quest reward text decryption====
The first operation to be applied to the quest reward text seems obvious, either from the <code>DEroRRiM</code> (<code>MiRRorED</code> if mirrored) text or from the nature of the text, it being a simple mirror of the whole text block. After a mirror, the paragraph <code>First truth is, at the base you see the sum of 4 and 6, second truth is that thirteen is false number</code> is revealed, making us understand that the number 13 should be eliminated in all further findings and that the base being used for them will be 64, instead of the human-used 10. Thus, after removing the already used text, removing the number 13 and decoding the text from Base64, we can observe the following text: <code>thirteen is rot ten number as well, rotate yourself out of it</code> which indicates the use of the rot13 cipher. After another removal of our used text and a rot13 decryption we can observe the following lines: <code>Affine brought you two of the first numbers</code> coupled with <code>vjg pwodgt qh uycp ykvjjqnfu hkxg</code> and <code>how many steps should emperor of rome walk, one or three</code> coupled with <code>bgufs efbmjoh xjui txbot, zpv xjmm gjoe zpvstfmg jo b trvbsf pg gpvs / wkhuh lv d vshfldo sodfh wr uhyhdo brxuvhoi lq d vkdsh ri wxeh, wkh vkruw zdb wx.eh</code> which indicate the Affine and  Caesar ciphers respectively. After decyphering the Affine encoded text with the values <code>a = 1; b = 2</code> we obtain <code>the number of swan withholds five</code> and after decoding the Caesar encoded texts with a shift of 1 and 3 respectively we obtain after dealing with <code>swans, you will find yourself in a square of four / there is a special place to reveal yourself in a shape of tube, the short way tu.be</code>, both clues helping later. 

====Piecing everything together====
To continue, we'll start with the remainder of our quest reward text: <code>266b2269726c336c4261</code> a hex encoded string which we should not decrypt for now. The clue <code>the number of swan withholds five</code> shows that 2 (a number which looks similar to a swan) should be replaced by the number 5, doing so in our hex text and then finally decoding it, indicated by the <code>square of four</code> clue, giving us <code>VkUiul3lEa</code>. Looking closely at the obtained string, we can observe the existence of the word <code>killa</code> within it, the clue <code>6t the end of it 6ll, you must kill the kill6</code> telling us to remove it from the text. Doing so will finally reveal the text <code>VUu3E</code> which if attached to the <code>UrAgCe</code> string obtained earlier, and being added onto a YouTube short link, as indicated by <code>there is a special place to reveal yourself in a shape of tube, the short way tu.be</code> revealing a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UrAgCeVUu3E YouTube video].

====The pastebin====
Approximately a week after finding the first YouTube video, a [https://pastebin.com/F9xx5TAs Pastebin link] surfaced in the video description. For ease in describing the decryption progress, we'll split the document in 4 sections, one for each paragraph and will start with the last one since it exposes the 1st step within the process.

=====Paragraph 4=====
The paragraph is Base64 encoded, but before decoding it, all characters that are found surrounded by a <code>+</code> character need to be deleted and the contents need to be set aside to form the string <code>524f543437</code> which equates to <code>ROT47</code> in hexadecimal. After the removal of the odd characters, the text <code>File119111====T10p2 ...Be advised, we've  got... (transmission interrupted)====end of file</code> is revealed. We can note down the "file number" as the rest is just flavor text.

=====Paragraph 3=====
Using the former ROT47 clue we can solve this paragraph, applying a ROT47 decryption after a Base64 decode yielding the content we need, but slightly malformed. To clear this malformation every 22nd character in the original string needs to be removed (all of the characters being a 0), thus revealing <code>File108070107==== T10p1 Overseer, this is team 8 unit 13 Foreman callsign. We got ambushed, requesting backup.... ====end of file</code>. Like the last paragraph, we can ignore all text besides the file number.

=====Paragraph 2=====
After a reverse of this paragraph we can observe the string <code>m1560red})>/|:\<({4lphab3t</code> (originally <code>t3bahpl4{(<\:|/>)}der0651m</code>) is an outlier and will serve as a clue later, so we can remove it. The rest of the paragraph (still reversed) can simply be Base64 decoded to find <code>File086078121==== OVRp2 ...Possible locals ambush. ====end of file</code>. As with the former paragraphs, keep the file number and ignore the rest.

=====Paragraph 1=====
As with the former paragraphs we start with a simple Base64 decode. We can now take the <code>m1560red})>/|:\<({4lphab3t</code> clue and use it as a substitute alphabet while ignoring the importat numbers, giving us the <code>File082056117==== OVRp1 team 10, recon detail, moving to polikhim 1-12. backup call from team 8, unknown detail.... ====end of file</code> string, which again, can be disregarded besides the file number.

====Finale====
Concatenating all file numbers together yields <code>082056117086078121108070107119111</code>. If we group the characters and get their coresponding ASCII character, we obtain <code>R8uVNylFkwo</code> which leads to the final [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R8uVNylFkwo YouTube video]. The video had a few game keys in its description.
